title: Melody
short: Robert Schumann · C 4/4 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: The first piece in the album Schumann wrote in 1848 for his three daughters. The right hand sings a slow tune while the left hand flows in eighth notes. Both hands read the treble clef here. Play softly, and let each phrase rise and fall like a sung line.

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: Album for the Young, Op. 68, No. 1 (1848)
